title: The Memo Sean Lane Sent the Day Olive Cut 450 Jobs
conflicts: Total funding: over $800 million (Rock Health), over $850 million in nine rounds (Telecare Aware), over $900 million (HIT Consultant boilerplate); story uses 'more than $800 million'. Severance described differently by Business First (at least ten weeks' pay plus two months of benefits) and the Dispatch (60 days' pay and benefits plus two weeks per year of service); story uses Business First. A Telecare Aware sentence about a further July layoff of 450 appears to repeat the 2022 cut and is not used.
notes: Episode shifted from the October 2023 shutdown to the July 2022 layoff memo, because no loadable source gives Lane's own account of the shutdown (Axios, Becker's, Fierce, MobiHealthNews and FirstWord all return 403); the 2023 sales and wind-down are told as the aftermath, and the story does not say who made the final decision. Arc set to hard-responsibility. Stance complicates. Blame is attributed only in Lane's and the company's own words; critical press and editorial comparisons are not repeated.
